column1: # Example input for oil_headspace.py (tab-separated; lines starting with # are ignored).
# Only 'id' is required: a PubChem CID or a full InChI.
# Optional columns, leave blank to use the defaults:
#   psat_pa       vapor pressure at the run temperature [Pa] (overrides thermo's value)
#   density_g_ml  density of the neat odorant [g/mL] (used to convert v/v)
#   abraham_L     Abraham L descriptor, log10 K(hexadecane/air) at 25 C (e.g. from the UFZ-LSER database)
#   logK          measured log10 K(oil/air) at the run temperature
#   groups        Dortmund UNIFAC subgroups as "id:count id:count", e.g. "1:1 2:1 14:1" for ethanol
# Linalool's psat_pa (0.17 mmHg at 25 C, supplier data) replaces thermo's estimate (~170 Pa), which is ~8x too high.
